complexity.notes: The manual scan-and-insert can be replaced by bisect.insort, though insertion into the list stays O(n) either way. A faster design reaches O(log k) per add by keeping ||only the k largest values in a min-heap, whose root is the answer||; that would make n adds O(n log k) total instead of O(n^2). Minor: List is used in the annotation without an import; under PEP 649 deferred evaluation this never raises, but importing from typing would be cleaner.
complexity.summary: Keeps the stream in a sorted list; each add does a linear scan to find the insertion point, inserts, and returns the element at index -k. Across n adds on a growing list this is O(n^2) total.
complexity.time_average: O(n) per add (O(m log m) construction for m initial values)
complexity.time_worst: O(n) per add (O(m log m) construction for m initial values)
